WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Information and Communication Technology

2. When learning Hand Tools and equipment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Hand Tools and equipment.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hand Tools and equipment.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hand Tools and equipment.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hand Tools and equipment.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables

4. When learning Overview of Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Woodwork.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Woodwork.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Woodwork.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Woodwork.

5. When learning Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Conversion and Seasoning 2.3 Adhesives 3.0 Tim, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Conversion and Seasoning 2.3 Adhesives 3.0 Tim.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Conversion and Seasoning 2.3 Adhesives 3.0 Tim.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Conversion and Seasoning 2.3 Adhesives 3.0 Tim.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Conversion and Seasoning 2.3 Adhesives 3.0 Tim.

6. When learning Growth of timber trees, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Growth of timber trees.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Growth of timber trees.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Growth of timber trees.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Growth of timber trees.

7. When learning Adhesives, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Adhesives.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Adhesives.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Adhesives.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Adhesives.

8. When learning Timber conversion and seasoning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber conversion and seasoning.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timber conversion and seasoning.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Timber conversion and seasoning.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timber conversion and seasoning.

9. When learning Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.

10. When learning Preparation of Wood, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Preparation of Wood.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Preparation of Wood.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Preparation of Wood.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Preparation of Wood.

11. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. CPU

12. When learning Wood Workshop, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wood Workshop.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Wood Workshop.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wood Workshop.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wood Workshop.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Adhesives and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Preparation of Wood and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Information and Communication Technology

2. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hand Tools and equipment.

3. C — Never touch live wires with wet hands

4. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Woodwork.

5. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Conversion and Seasoning 2.3 Adhesives 3.0 Tim.

6. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Growth of timber trees.

7. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Adhesives.

8. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber conversion and seasoning.

9. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.

10. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Preparation of Wood.

11. D — CPU

12. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wood Workshop.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Adhesives; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project ; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Preparation of Wood; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
